scope: Layout defects from the 16/11 review compared with the VN client and fixed on the 949x diagnostic client: vi and en review recipes (vi-04, en-05) with the compact 12x12 Gulim from tools/l10n_949x.py vnfonts and locally overridden strings (local/review-fix/override_cs.py on copies of the 11632f2 UTF-8 builds; boom-re-l10n not modified). VN comparison images are the VN client runtime screenshots kept in boom-re docs (commit aebbcc9 and earlier), copied under local/review-fix/vn.
observation: KR 00967 UI is 800x600 with layouts as constants in the exe (no layout files in the packs); the VN client UI is 1024x768 with taller controls, so VN 16-row fonts fit there. Recipient field: VN shows '<Mọi người>' whole in a taller field; on 00967 the 12-row field clipped the 15-row VN Gulim, and the compact 12x12 Gulim shows the dot below and the g descender (vi-before-after.png). Players label: VN also draws the value at a fixed offset (raw key PREMAX overlapped by the value in vn-chat_room.png); 'Số chỗ' (39 px, like en 'Players' 41 px) no longer overlaps '8'. Game-type button: VN also lets long text run past the button (raw keys in vn-create_room_dialog.png); 'Bắt thủ lĩnh' (65 px) and 'Leader Hunt' (69 px) fit where 'Bắt đội trưởng' (81) and 'Catch the Leader' (97) overflowed. Mode label: 'Even Teams' (70 px) is no longer covered by the Any checkbox. Chat tip: the chat log wraps by character width without word breaks; an explicit newline in the csysstr string makes the en tip break between words. PREMAX, CreateDlgGameTypeFlagHunt and CreateDlgModeManner exist in both ClientString and csysstr.ssd and the client shows the csysstr value.
cleanup: Raw export passed for both runs.
limits: VN screenshots come from earlier boom-re runtime captures, not a new VN run; they show raw keys where the server had not sent strings, so they compare layout mechanics, not VN wording. String fixes are local overrides; the catalog fix belongs to boom-re-l10n. Word wrap itself is not changed in the exe.
